title: Tofu and Baby Broccoli Stir-Fry
subtitle: with Golden Rice and Spring Onion
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you're vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Cook rice: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Put the rice, 3 tsp curry powder and 250ml (1 cup) water in a small saucepan and stir to combine. Cover and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 mins or until tender and the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for at least 5 mins. Fluff the rice with a fork.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, thinly slice the onion. Trim the baby broccoli and halve lengthwise. Halve the carrot lengthwise, then thinly slice on an angle. Finely chop the spring onion. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Quarter the tofu pieces. Combine the garlic, remaining curry powder, 1 tbs soy sauce and 3 tsp sugar in a bowl.
Warm tofu: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden and warmed through. Remove from the pan.

Stir-fry veggies: Heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in the same pan over high heat. Stir-fry the onion for 2-3 mins until slightly softened. Add the baby broccoli and carrot and stir-fry for 3 mins or until tender but still with crunch. Add the tofu and soy sauce mixture and stir-fry for 1-2 mins until the sauce is slightly thickened. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Divide the rice and tofu stir-fry among bowls. Scatter over the spring onion and enjoy!
Make it spicy: If you like a kick of heat, scatter over a pinch of chilli flakes or thinly sliced fresh chilli just before serving.
